verdict.rationale: Daytona documents a first-party Network Limits feature: each sandbox runs behind a firewall that controls which external IPs and domains it can reach. The firewall parameters can be set at sandbox creation or updated while the sandbox runs, which gives explicit, programmable egress policy. Missing for 10: detailed policy syntax (explicit allow vs. deny modes, CIDR/domain rule format) and independent or hands-on corroboration that the egress firewall works as claimed.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can restrict or allow the sandbox's network egress with explicit policy

citations.quote: Network limits control outbound internet access from sandboxes. Each sandbox runs behind a firewall that restricts which external IP addresses and domains it can reach
Set firewall parameters when creating a sandbox or update them while the sandbox is running.
preventing untrusted code from exfiltrating data or contacting arbitrary hosts.
